s0401.literal: On dingchou day the Emperor proceeded to Daming Hall and received the Burma envoy's tribute audience.
s0401.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Emperor proceeded to Daming Hall and received the Burma envoy's tribute audience.

s0403.literal: Princess Maidi was granted fifty thousand ingots of notes and consort Mielian twenty-five thousand ingots of notes.
s0403.idiomatic: Princess Maidi was granted 50,000 ingots of notes and consort Mielian 25,000 ingots of notes.

s0404.literal: Prince Taiping was summoned to Bian.
s0404.idiomatic: Prince Taiping was summoned to Bian.

s0405.literal: Corvée laborers were levied to dredge the Xiaozhigu Bai River.
s0405.idiomatic: Corvée laborers were levied to dredge the Xiaozhigu Bai River.

s0406.literal: On gengchen day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Taipuhua, Song Ben, and sixty-four others were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.
s0406.idiomatic: On gengchen day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Taipuhua, Song Ben, and 64 others were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.

s0407.literal: On xinsi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0407.idiomatic: On xinsi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0408.literal: Envoys were dispatched to bestow on Western Region Sakya monks two hundred fifty taels of gold, two thousand two hundred taels of silver, and twenty thousand kasayas, with silks, cloths, banners, and tea each in varying amounts.
s0408.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to bestow on Western Region Sakya monks 250 taels of gold, 2,200 taels of silver, and 20,000 kasayas, with silks, cloths, banners, and tea each in varying amounts.

s0409.literal: On renwu day the incantation master Dorji was dispatched to the two countries of Yaji and Banbu to fetch Buddhist scriptures.
s0409.idiomatic: On renwu day the incantation master Dorji was dispatched to the two countries of Yaji and Banbu to fetch Buddhist scriptures.

s0410.literal: On guimou day regulations were issued for imperial pearl kasayas.
s0410.idiomatic: On guimou day regulations were issued for imperial pearl kasayas.

s0411.literal: On jiashen day an edict directed compilation of the Veritable Records of Emperor Renzong and biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers.
s0411.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict directed compilation of the Veritable Records of Emperor Renzong and biographies of empresses and meritorious ministers.

s0412.literal: On yiyou day the gold-letter Western Region Prajna Sutra of Baoji Monastery was completed; it was placed in the Inner Palace Incense Hall, and garrison troops for Shou'an Mountain temple construction were increased.
s0412.idiomatic: On yiyou day the gold-letter Western Region Prajna Sutra of Baoji Monastery was completed; it was placed in the Inner Palace Incense Hall, and garrison troops for Shou'an Mountain temple construction were increased.

s0413.literal: On jichou day a qilin was born in Datong Circuit.
s0413.idiomatic: On jichou day a qilin was born in Datong Circuit.

s0414.literal: On jiawu day the Yunnan princely establishment was established.
s0414.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Yunnan princely establishment was established.

s0415.literal: On jihai day the eunuch Boluo Temür was convicted and banished to Nurgan territory.
s0415.idiomatic: On jihai day the eunuch Boluo Temür was convicted and banished to Nurgan territory.

s0416.literal: On gengzi day Ningguo Circuit famine was relieved.
s0416.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ningguo Circuit famine was relieved.

s0417.literal: On xinchou day Tieshi was made censor-in-chief, granted a gold tally, and put in command of the Zhongyi Guard Elite Army Command.
s0417.idiomatic: On xinchou day Tieshi was made censor-in-chief, granted a gold tally, and put in command of the Zhongyi Guard Elite Army Command.

s0418.literal: On guimou day Yidu and Banyang suffered famine; grain was granted in relief.
s0418.idiomatic: On guimou day Yidu and Banyang suffered famine; grain was granted in relief.

s0419.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingwu day a silver seal was granted to Prince Nandashi's establishment, rank 3a;
s0419.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingwu day a silver seal was granted to Prince Nandashi's establishment, rank 3a;

s0420.literal: Kuanzhe and Khutemishi's establishments were granted copper seals, rank 3b.
s0420.idiomatic: Kuanzhe and Khutemishi's establishments were granted copper seals, rank 3b.

s0421.literal: On gengxu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0421.idiomatic: On gengxu day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0422.literal: Jiangzhou, Ganzhou, and Linjiang had prolonged rain; Yuanzhou and Jianchang had drought; the people all reported famine; forty-eight thousand shi of grain were issued in relief.
s0422.idiomatic: Jiangzhou, Ganzhou, and Linjiang had prolonged rain; Yuanzhou and Jianchang had drought; the people all reported famine; 48,000 shi of grain were issued in relief.

s0423.literal: On dingsi day Guangde Circuit suffered drought; nine thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0423.idiomatic: On dingsi day Guangde Circuit suffered drought; 9,000 shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0424.literal: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon Heart.
s0424.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0425.literal: On jiwei day an elephant chariot with a gilt-ridge hall was constructed.
s0425.idiomatic: On jiwei day an elephant chariot with a gilt-ridge hall was constructed.

s0426.literal: Jiyang Li tribesmen raided Ningyuan County.
s0426.idiomatic: Jiyang Li tribesmen raided Ningyuan County.

s0427.literal: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Dipper.
s0427.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Dipper.

s0428.literal: On wuchen day an edict granted a stele to Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather.
s0428.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict granted a stele to Tiemudie'er's father and grandfather.

s0429.literal: The eunuch Boluotai was appointed acting director of the Directorate of Grand Ceremony; Grand Ceremony officials said a man under criminal penalty could not participate in the great sacrifice, so the appointment was revoked.
s0429.idiomatic: The eunuch Boluotai was appointed acting director of the Directorate of Grand Ceremony; Grand Ceremony officials said a man under criminal penalty could not participate in the great sacrifice, so the appointment was revoked.

s0430.literal: Fifth month, on bingzi day the Huihui mosque at Shangdu was demolished and the site used to build the Imperial Preceptor hall.
s0430.idiomatic: Fifth month, on bingzi day the Huihui mosque at Shangdu was demolished and the site used to build the Imperial Preceptor hall.

s0431.literal: Yidu and Jiaozhou famine was relieved.
s0431.idiomatic: Yidu and Jiaozhou famine was relieved.

s0432.literal: On dingchou day Bazhou had locusts.
s0432.idiomatic: On dingchou day Bazhou had locusts.

s0433.literal: On wuyin day Venus encroached upon Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi and the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0433.idiomatic: On wuyin day Venus encroached upon Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi and the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0434.literal: On gengchen day the moon encroached upon Mingtang.
s0434.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon encroached upon Mingtang.

s0435.literal: Puzhou suffered great famine; local authorities were ordered to relieve it.
s0435.idiomatic: Puzhou suffered great famine; local authorities were ordered to relieve it.

s0436.literal: On renwu day Imperial Prince Toghtemür was moved to Hainan.
s0436.idiomatic: On renwu day Imperial Prince Toghtemür was moved to Hainan.

s0437.literal: Day-masters were forbidden to associate with princes and imperial sons-in-law; those in charge of the five divisions of yin-yang were forbidden to leak prognostications.
s0437.idiomatic: Day-masters were forbidden to associate with princes and imperial sons-in-law; those in charge of the five divisions of yin-yang were forbidden to leak prognostications.

s0438.literal: Because Xingguo Circuit had drought last year, its land rent was remitted.
s0438.idiomatic: Because Xingguo Circuit had drought last year, its land rent was remitted.

s0439.literal: On dinghai day Buddhist rites were performed at the Great Peace Pavilion.
s0439.idiomatic: On dinghai day Buddhist rites were performed at the Great Peace Pavilion.

s0440.literal: On gengyin day Prince Habin Temür's following was relieved.
s0440.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Habin Temür's following was relieved.

s0441.literal: Zhang Yu of Yizhou was convicted of heterodox speech, and Daoist Li Tianxiang of Jinan was convicted of teaching martial arts; both were flogged.
s0441.idiomatic: Zhang Yu of Yizhou was convicted of heterodox speech, and Daoist Li Tianxiang of Jinan was convicted of teaching martial arts; both were flogged.

s0442.literal: Nineteen relay stations of the Jurchen Mangchi Xing division suffered famine and were relieved.
s0442.idiomatic: 19 relay stations of the Jurchen Mangchi Xing division suffered famine and were relieved.

s0443.literal: On xinmao day sea transport grain reached Zhigu; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god and Celestial Consort.
s0443.idiomatic: On xinmao day sea transport grain reached Zhigu; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god and Celestial Consort.

s0444.literal: A travelling hall was constructed at Jinshan's Floating-cup Pond.
s0444.idiomatic: A travelling hall was constructed at Jinshan's Floating-cup Pond.

s0446.literal: On guisi day flying insects ate mulberry trees in Baoding Circuit.
s0446.idiomatic: On guisi day flying insects ate mulberry trees in Baoding Circuit.

s0447.literal: On yiwei day scions of established families who had come of age were ordered to enter the National University.
s0447.idiomatic: On yiwei day scions of established families who had come of age were ordered to enter the National University.

s0448.literal: On xinchou day the Directorate of Grand Ceremony submitted diagrams of the Grand Ancestral Temple regulations.
s0448.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Directorate of Grand Ceremony submitted diagrams of the Grand Ancestral Temple regulations.

s0449.literal: On renyin day Kaiyuan Circuit had prolonged rain.
s0449.idiomatic: On renyin day Kaiyuan Circuit had prolonged rain.

s0450.literal: Sixth month, on guimou new moon there was a solar eclipse.
s0450.idiomatic: Sixth month, on guimou new moon there was a solar eclipse.

s0451.literal: A golden pagoda was constructed at Shangdu to enshrine Buddhist relics.
s0451.idiomatic: A golden pagoda was constructed at Shangdu to enshrine Buddhist relics.

s0452.literal: On yimao day Tiemudie'er was put in charge of the Xuanzheng Bureau.
s0452.idiomatic: On yimao day Tiemudie'er was put in charge of the Xuanzheng Bureau.

s0453.literal: On dingsi day Associate Administrator Jing Yan was dismissed and made censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.
s0453.idiomatic: On dingsi day associate administrator Jing Yan was dismissed and made censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.

s0454.literal: On wuwu day Jing Prefecture had hail.
s0454.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jing Prefecture had hail.

s0455.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Void Beam.
s0455.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Void Beam.

s0456.literal: Chuzhou's prolonged rain damaged the crops; its rent was remitted.
s0456.idiomatic: Chuzhou's prolonged rain damaged the crops; its rent was remitted.

s0457.literal: On xinyou day Venus crossed the meridian.
s0457.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus crossed the meridian.

s0458.literal: Zhao Hongzuo and others memorialized; they were ordered to return to their home districts and still forbidden from recklessly discussing current affairs.
s0458.idiomatic: Zhao Hongzuo and others memorialized; they were ordered to return to their home districts and still forbidden from recklessly discussing current affairs.

s0459.literal: On renxu day Zhang Sicheng of Dragon-Tiger Mountain came to court and was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way.
s0459.idiomatic: On renxu day Zhang Sicheng of Dragon-Tiger Mountain came to court and was granted the title Great Perfect Man of Supreme Mystery, Assisting Transformation, Embodying Benevolence, and Responding to the Way.

s0460.literal: On yichou day envoys were dispatched to select frontier-district officials in the five provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan.
s0460.idiomatic: On yichou day envoys were dispatched to select frontier-district officials in the five provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan.

s0461.literal: On dingmao day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0461.idiomatic: On dingmao day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0463.literal: On wuchen day Weihui, Bianliang, and other places had locusts.
s0463.idiomatic: On wuchen day Weihui, Bianliang, and other places had locusts.

s0464.idiomatic: On jisi day Shangdu garrison commissioner Jirihala was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0465.literal: Linjiang Circuit suffered drought; its rent was remitted.
s0465.idiomatic: Linjiang Circuit suffered drought; its rent was remitted.

s0466.literal: Tongji garrison-farm had prolonged rain that damaged crops; Bazhou had great flooding; the Hun River overflowed — twenty-three thousand three hundred households were affected.
s0466.idiomatic: Tongji garrison-farm had prolonged rain that damaged crops; Bazhou had great flooding; the Hun River overflowed — 23,300 households were affected.

s0467.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was granted one million ingots of notes.
s0467.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was granted 1 million ingots of notes.

s0468.literal: Liaoyang, Kaiyuan, and other circuits and Shunzhou, Xingtai, and other counties had great flooding.
s0468.idiomatic: Liaoyang, Kaiyuan, and other circuits and Shunzhou, Xingtai, and other counties had great flooding.

s0469.literal: On guiyou day Weihui Circuit's Zuocheng County had locusts.
s0469.idiomatic: On guiyou day Weihui Circuit's Zuocheng County had locusts.

s0470.literal: On yihai day Nan'en and Xin Prefectures famine was relieved.
s0470.idiomatic: On yihai day Nan'en and Xin Prefectures famine was relieved.

s0471.literal: On bingzi day Huai'an Circuit's subordinate counties had flooding.
s0471.idiomatic: On bingzi day Huai'an Circuit's subordinate counties had flooding.

s0472.literal: On dingchou day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0472.idiomatic: On dingchou day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0473.literal: On wuyin day the Yu and Lidi rivers in Tongzhou's Lu County burst their banks.
s0473.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Yu and Lidi rivers in Tongzhou's Lu County burst their banks.

s0474.literal: On gengchen day the escort retinue was completed.
s0474.idiomatic: On gengchen day the escort retinue was completed.

s0475.literal: The Hutuo River and Juma River in Fanyang County overflowed.
s0475.idiomatic: The Hutuo River and Juma River in Fanyang County overflowed.

s0476.literal: On xinsi day the Zhouzhi County monk Yuanming rebelled; Privy Council vice-director Zhang Tai was dispatched to command troops to capture him.
s0476.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Zhouzhi County monk Yuanming rebelled; privy council vice-director Zhang Tai was dispatched to command troops to capture him.

s0477.literal: On renwu day Tongxu, Linhuai, Xuyi, and other counties had locusts.
s0477.idiomatic: On renwu day Tongxu, Linhuai, Xuyi, and other counties had locusts.

s0478.literal: On guiwei day Grand Master of Ceremonies Bolanxi was enfeoffed as Duke of Harmony State.
s0478.idiomatic: On guiwei day Grand Master of Ceremonies Bolanxi was enfeoffed as Duke of Harmony State.

s0479.literal: On yiyou day heavy rain caused the Hun River dikes to break.
s0479.idiomatic: On yiyou day heavy rain caused the Hun River dikes to break.

s0480.literal: On gengyin day Qingchi County had locusts.
s0480.idiomatic: On gengyin day Qingchi County had locusts.

s0481.literal: On guisi day the moon encroached upon Mao.
s0481.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon encroached upon Mao.

s0482.idiomatic: Lupeng of Huangping Prefecture's tribesmen became bandits; wanhu He Zhiqi and others had their offices reduced one grade.

s0483.literal: Ministry of Personnel director Jiaohua and Ministry of Rites section director Wen Ju were dispatched as envoys to Annam to proclaim the accession edict.
s0483.idiomatic: Ministry of Personnel director Jiaohua and Ministry of Rites section director Wen Ju were dispatched as envoys to Annam to proclaim the accession edict.

s0484.literal: Prince Kuobie died; ten thousand five hundred ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.
s0484.idiomatic: Prince Kuobie died; 10,500 ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.

s0485.literal: On bingshen day dress colors exceeding regulation were forbidden.
s0485.idiomatic: On bingshen day dress colors exceeding regulation were forbidden.

s0486.literal: On jihai day the imperial portraits of Renzong and the Emperor were installed at the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.
s0486.idiomatic: On jihai day the imperial portraits of Renzong and the Emperor were installed at the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.

s0488.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shangdu city was repaired.

s0489.idiomatic: An edict directed displaced persons in Henan and Jiang-Zhe to return to their occupations.
